texts: good. the begin event, the thirty-night solo stretch with its Harbor Station location, and the Year 1 date all land, and the stretch witness is reused as the anchor for every later 'during the solo stretch' clause. One caveat you cannot write around: 'day 230 of Year 1' goes into the calendar day-of-month slot as (Day 230), because the translator has no day-of-year term - harmless as long as your calendar never also names months.

good. the non-accompaniment is denied as one bundle - event class, Pell as agent, Coraline Ash as theme, past tense and the 'during the solo stretch' link all inside the denial - which is exactly the right shape, and Pell's name stays outside it.

bad: 'her own off-nights' is flattened to the bare kind symbol off_night, so the parse claims Pell visited on off-nights in general and silently drops the restriction that they were her own nights off; the decomposition also asserts that an off-night is a kind of 'off', which is not a property a night can have. Rewrite the restriction as a finite condition clause with Pell as its explicit subject: 'Whenever Pell was free at night, Pell visited the Harbor Station.' That keeps the possessor (it is Pell who is free), the night, and the recurrence, and yields one visit event per occasion.

good. the tending is carried in full: Coraline Ash as agent, the Harbor Station's lantern as the object, 'every night' as the night slot plus a one-day period, and the link bounding the habit to the solo stretch.
good. 'lit' lemmatizes to light on the same lantern symbol, with sundown in the time slot, the nightly period, and the bound to the solo stretch.
good. the mire-essence gets its own witness and a mire_essence to essence genus, with midnight, the nightly period and the stretch bound all present.

good. 'the third watch' is kept as a bare named time-slot symbol, which is the right treatment for a named period; note that the wick is deliberately left unlinked to the lantern, since this sentence does not state that link.
good. extinguish, the reused lantern symbol, dawn, the nightly period and the bound to the solo stretch are all there.
good. keep takes Coraline Ash as agent and the notebook as theme with 'carefully' as manner; the sentence supplies no time, so none is recorded and nothing ties this to the solo stretch.
